arxiv-2112-11885.title: Intertwining and Duality for Consistent Markov Processes
arxiv-2112-11885.creator: Simone Floreani, Sabine Jansen, Frank Redig, Stefan Wagner
arxiv-2112-11885.description: Abstract In this paper we derive intertwining relations for a broad class of conservative particle systems both in discrete and continuous setting. Using the language of point process theory, we are able to derive a natural framework in which duality and intertwining can be formulated. We prove falling factorial and orthogonal polynomial intertwining relations in a general setting.

arxiv-2208-00539.title: Is current research on adversarial robustness addressing the right problem?
arxiv-2208-00539.creator: Ali Borji
arxiv-2208-00539.description: Abstract Short answer: Yes, Long answer: No! Indeed, research on adversarial robustness has led to invaluable insights helping us understand and explore different aspects of the problem. Many attacks and defenses have been proposed over the last couple of years. The problem, however, remains largely unsolved and poorly understood.

arxiv-2210-11916.title: Adjoint-based Control of Three Dimensional Stokes Droplets Journal: Journal of Computational Physics
arxiv-2210-11916.creator: Alexandru Fikl, Daniel J. Bodony
arxiv-2210-11916.description: Abstract We develop a continuous adjoint formulation and implementation for controlling the deformation of clean, neutrally buoyant droplets in Stokes flow through farfield velocity boundary conditions. The focus is on dynamics where surface tension plays an important role through the Young-Laplace law.

arxiv-2310-03877.title: Sturm-Hurwitz theorem for quantum graphs
arxiv-2310-03877.creator: Ram Band, Philippe Charron
arxiv-2310-03877.description: Abstract . We prove upper and lower bounds for the number of zeroes of linear combinations of Schrödinger eigenfunctions on metric (quantum) graphs. These bounds are distinct from both the interval and manifolds. We complement these bounds by giving non-trivial examples for the lower bound as well as sharp examples for the upper bound.

arxiv-2310-18965.title: Power of Counting by Nonuniform Families of
arxiv-2310-18965.description: Abstract Lately, there have been intensive studies on strengths and limitations of nonuniform families of promise decision problems solvable by various types of polynomial-size finite automata families, where “polynomial-size” refers to the polynomially-bounded state complexity of a finite automata family.

arxiv-2311-13680.title: Qudit Stabilizer Codes, CFTs, and Topological Surfaces
arxiv-2311-13680.creator: Matthew Buican, Rajath Radhakrishnan
arxiv-2311-13680.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Matthew Buican, Rajath Radhakrishnan. We study general maps from the space of rational CFTs with a fixed chiral algebra and associated Chern-Simons (CS) theories to the space of qudit stabilizer codes with a fixed generalized Pauli group. We consider certain natural constraints on such a map and show that the map can be described as a graph homomorphism from an orbifold graph, which captures the orbifold structure of CFTs, to a code graph, which captures the structure of self-dual stabilizer codes.

arxiv-2403-19077.title: Blockchains, MEV and the knapsack problem: a primer Thanks: This research is funded by The Ethereum Foundation Academic Grant Program no. FY22-0682. The authors thank Barnabé Monnot for useful discussions and feedback on the content and implementation of this grant project.
arxiv-2403-19077.creator: Vijay Mohan, Peyman Khezr
arxiv-2403-19077.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Vijay Mohan, Peyman Khezr. In this paper, we take a close look at a problem labeled maximal extractable value (MEV), which arises in a blockchain due to the ability of a block producer to manipulate the order of transactions within a block. Indeed, blockchains such as Ethereum have spent considerable resources addressing this issue and have redesigned the block production process to account for MEV. This paper provides an overview of the MEV problem and tracks how Ethereum has adapted to its presence.

arxiv-2408-11283.title: Inference Plans for Hybrid Particle Filtering
arxiv-2408-11283.creator: Ellie Y. Cheng, Eric Atkinson, Guillaume Baudart, Louis Mandel, Michael Carbin
arxiv-2408-11283.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ellie Y. Cheng, Eric Atkinson, Guillaume Baudart, Louis Mandel, Michael Carbin. Advanced probabilistic programming languages (PPLs) using hybrid particle filtering combine symbolic exact inference and Monte Carlo methods to improve inference performance. These systems use heuristics to partition random variables within the program into variables that are encoded symbolically and variables that are encoded with sampled values, and the heuristics are not necessarily aligned with the developer’s performance evaluation metrics.

The work of J. Shiraishi was supp
arxiv-2411-08607.creator: Van Phuc Bui, Junya Shiraishi, Petar Popovski, Shashi Raj Pandey
arxiv-2411-08607.description: Abstract Training a high-quality Federated Learning (FL) model at the network edge is challenged by limited transmission resources. Although various device scheduling strategies have been proposed, it remains unclear how scheduling decisions affect the FL model performance under temporal constraints.

arxiv-2412-02390.title: Estimating Photometric Redshifts for Galaxies from the DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys with Bayesian Neural Networks Trained by DESI EDR
arxiv-2412-02390.creator: Xingchen Zhou, Nan Li, Hu Zou, Yan Gong, Furen Deng, Xuelei Chen, Qian Yu, Zizhao He, Boyi Ding
arxiv-2412-02390.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xingchen Zhou, Nan Li, Hu Zou, Yan Gong, Furen Deng, Xuelei Chen, Qian Yu, Zizhao He, Boyi Ding. We present a catalogue of photometric redshifts for galaxies from DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys, which includes ∼ 0.18 \sim 0.18 billion sources covering 14,000 deg 2 \deg^{2} .

arxiv-2501-17339.title: Multiplexed color centers in a silicon photonic cavity array
arxiv-2501-17339.creator: Lukasz Komza, Xueyue Zhang, Hanbin Song, Yu-Lung Tang, Xin Wei, Alp Sipahigil
arxiv-2501-17339.description: Abstract Entanglement distribution is central to the modular scaling of quantum processors and establishing quantum networks. Color centers with telecom-band transitions and long spin coherence times are suitable candidates for long-distance entanglement distribution. However, high-bandwidth memory-enhanced quantum communication is limited by high-yield, scalable creation of efficient spin-photon interfaces.

arxiv-2510-06713.title: Spectropolarimetry of NGC 1275 reveals a narrow-line radio galaxy with polarization parallel to its radio jet axis
arxiv-2510-06713.creator: F. Marin, T. Pursimo, I. Liodakis, E. Lindfors, J. Biedermann, D. Hutsemékers, M. Turkki
arxiv-2510-06713.description: Abstract Concomitant with the Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE) observation of the Perseus cluster, we obtained optical spectropolarimetry of its central active galactic nucleus, NGC 1275, using the Alhambra Faint Object Spectrograph and Camera (ALFOSC) on the Nordic Optical Telescope (NOT).

arxiv-2511-21935.title: Breaking Algorithmic Collusion in Human-AI Ecosystems
arxiv-2511-21935.creator: Natalie Collina, Eshwar Ram Arunachaleswaran, Meena Jagadeesan
arxiv-2511-21935.description: Abstract AI agents are increasingly deployed in ecosystems where they repeatedly interact not only with each other but also with humans. In this work, we study these human-AI ecosystems from a theoretical perspective, focusing on the classical framework of repeated pricing games.

pmc-11674050.title: Real-World Open-Label Experience with Rimegepant for the Acute Treatment of Migraine Attacks: A Multicenter Pilot Study
pmc-11674050.creator: Emmanouil V Dermitzakis, Dimitrios Rikos, Michail Vikelis, Georgia Xiromerisiou, Styliani Zisopoulou, Dimitrios Rallis, Panagiotis Soldatos, George S Vlachos, Georgios G Vasiliadis, Andreas A Argyriou, Milija D Mijajlović
pmc-11674050.description: Objectives: The present open-label multicenter pilot study sought to prospectively evaluate the efficacy and safety of rimegepant in treating migraine attacks. Methods: The primary endpoint was pain freedom at two hours post-dose, while the co-primary efficacy endpoints included a reduction in the headache intensity and freedom from the most bothersome symptoms (MBS) associated with migraine at the same time point.

pmc-12632253.title: The type IV pilus steering committee: how Pil-Chp controls directional motility
pmc-12632253.creator: Kaitlin D. Yarrington, Dominique H. Limoli
pmc-12632253.description: Many microbial species live on surfaces and employ various strategies for initiation of and survival within a surface-attached community. One such strategy implemented by many bacterial species is to move across surfaces using grappling hook-like appendages called type IV pili (TFP) which extend, attach to the surface, and retract to pull the cell body forward.

pmc-12849499.title: Building character strengths and virtues in Sri Lanka: a cluster randomized pre-post evaluation of a school-based intervention
pmc-12849499.creator: Suhail Asrar, Miyuru Chandradasa, Sonali Amarasekera, Angela Paric, Sivunadipathige Sumanasiri, Nisha Ravindran, Shehan Williams, Arun Ravindran
pmc-12849499.description: BackgroundSri Lanka (SL) is a multiethnic nation that has endured a decades-long civil war and a devastating tsunami. These events led to a widespread loss of life, displacement, destruction of family and social infrastructure, and economic collapse. Their impact was compounded by adverse social determinants such as poverty, unemployment, food insecurity, and homelessness.

pmc-13139425.title: Thermodynamic assessment of tri-reforming of methane with optimization of operating conditions to achieve suitable syngas for methanol production
pmc-13139425.creator: Amin Alamdari, Mohammad Javad Azarhoosh, Abbas Aghaeinejad-Meybodi
pmc-13139425.description: The present study consists of two parts. In the first part, a thermodynamic assessment of the reactions involved in the tri-reforming of methane (TRM) to syngas was conducted using a stoichiometric approach by simultaneously solving a system of nonlinear equilibrium equations.

pmc-13372776.title: Incidental thyroid carcinoma in surgically treated multinodular goiter: a retrospective study
pmc-13372776.creator: G. Pavone, E. Lamanna, M. Pacilli, E. Khoury, A. Ambrosi, N. Tartaglia
pmc-13372776.description: BackgroundMultinodular goiter (MNG) is a common thyroid disorder frequently encountered in clinical practice. Although it is generally considered a benign condition, thyroid carcinoma may occasionally be detected in patients undergoing surgery for MNG. The reported prevalence of malignancy in this setting varies widely across different populations and clinical series.

pmc-13493088.title: Clinical Outcome and Safety of Amnioreduction in Singleton Pregnancies with Severe Polyhydramnios
pmc-13493088.creator: Laia Grau, Míriam Pérez-Cruz, Mar Bennassar, Olga Gómez, Elisenda Eixarch, Narcís Masoller, Montserrat Izquierdo Renau, Eduard Gratacós, Josep M. Martínez, Joan Sabrià
pmc-13493088.description: IntroductionSevere polyhydramnios is associated with fetal anomalies and adverse perinatal outcomes. The safety of amnioreduction in singleton pregnancies remains unclear. We aimed to evaluate pregnancy outcomes and procedure-related complications of amnioreduction in singleton pregnancies with severe polyhydramnios, excluding other invasive procedures apart from diagnostic amniocentesis.
